name: Homo erectus

taxonomic_status.classification: Homo erectus (sensu lato, worldwide polytypic species — trending majority position)
alternative_classifications: Homo ergaster for early/African material, Homo erectus sensu stricto reserved for Asian material (Groves & Mazák 1975; defended on phylogenetic grounds by Wood & Collard 1999)
Homo georgicus proposed by some for the Dmanisi material specifically (minority position)

notes: Latest date (108,000 ya, Ngandong, Java) and earliest date (1.9 Ma, East Turkana) are both fossil-evidence bounds, not the true origin/extinction of the population.
